description: The frequency shifter as a device: a mode (shift or ring), the shift in hertz, the ring's frequency, the shifter's precision and a mix, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, its latency, what it does to a note and its harmonics and the worklet's source (the frequency shifter of @audio/effect-freqshift and the ring modulator of @audio/effect-ringmod), with no panel and no audio in it.
name: frequency-shifter-device
